intro_zh: Hard Lessons 的加更片段：主持人 Iliana Bouzali 和 Druckenmiller 玩词语联想——她说一个词，他说第一反应。从美国经济、收益率曲线、人形机器人、关税、加密货币，到中美关系、欧元、美元的储备地位和 Bessent / Warsh，很多回答都是「一句定性 + 一个但是」，正好练让步对比。

sents.en: Can we do some word association?
sents.zh: 我们来玩个词语联想好吗？

sents.en: Okay.
sents.zh: 好。

sents.en: So the way this works is, I say a word and you say whatever comes to mind.
sents.zh: 规则是这样：我说一个词，你说出脑子里冒出来的任何东西。

sents.en: Oh, boy.
sents.zh: 哎呀。

sents.en: Yep.
sents.zh: 对。

sents.en: US economy.
sents.zh: 美国经济。

sents.en: Strong.
sents.zh: 强劲。

sents.en: Biotech.
sents.zh: 生物科技。

sents.en: Exciting.
sents.zh: 令人兴奋。

sents.en: By the way, you can do full sentences, too.
sents.zh: 顺便说一句，你也可以说完整的句子。

sents.en: Only if you want to.
sents.zh: 只要你想的话。

sents.en: As you know, I'm somewhat abrupt.
sents.zh: 你知道的，我这人说话有点冲。

sents.en: I do.
sents.zh: 我知道。

sents.en: Retail investors.
sents.zh: 散户投资者。

sents.en: Formidable.
sents.zh: 不可小觑。

sents.en: Yield curve.
sents.zh: 收益率曲线。

sents.en: Overrated.
sents.zh: 被高估了。

sents.en: Really?
sents.zh: 真的吗？

sents.en: So, we're in with the equity as a macro indicator.
sents.zh: 这么说，宏观指标要看股市了。

sents.en: Out with the yield curve.
sents.zh: 收益率曲线就靠边站了。

sents.en: Oh no.
sents.zh: 噢，不是。

sents.en: It's a pretty good indicator.
sents.zh: 它是个挺好的指标。

hl.note: 让步的前半句：先承认它是个好指标，下一句再说「只是我不怎么交易它」。

sents.en: I've never traded the yield curve much.
sents.zh: 我只是从来没怎么交易过收益率曲线。

sents.en: I talked to my peers, I got the curve on, I'm like, look, rates are going to go up or they're going to go down.
sents.zh: 我跟同行聊，他们做曲线交易，我就想：听着，利率要么涨要么跌。

sents.en: When I say overrated, I misunderstood the word.
sents.zh: 我说「被高估」，是我理解错了这个词。

sents.en: No, I didn't misunderstand.
sents.zh: 不，我没理解错。

sents.en: It's what came to my head.
sents.zh: 那就是我脑子里冒出来的。

sents.en: I'm talking about trading the yield curve as opposed to just trading bonds outright.
sents.zh: 我说的是交易收益率曲线，而不是直接交易债券。

hl.text: as opposed to just trading bonds outright
hl.note: A as opposed to B：「是 A，而不是 B」，对比两种做法。

sents.en: Very rarely do you win on both sides.
sents.zh: 两头都赢的情况非常少见。

hl.text: Very rarely do you win on both sides
hl.note: 否定副词前置倒装：Very rarely do you…，强调「很少」。

sents.en: In other words, very rarely do short rates go down and long rates go up, which is what happened last year.
sents.zh: 换句话说，短端利率下行、长端利率上行，这种情况非常少见——而去年恰恰就是这样。

sents.en: But I had the down part correctly.
sents.zh: 不过下行那一半我判断对了。

sents.en: Humanoids.
sents.zh: 人形机器人。

sents.en: It's interesting because I asked my young partner, why should humanoids be like humans?
sents.zh: 这个有意思，因为我问过我的年轻合伙人：人形机器人为什么要做得像人？

sents.en: Why would that possibly be the most efficient form of robot?
sents.zh: 那怎么可能是机器人最高效的形态？

sents.en: And I expect him to say it's not.
sents.zh: 我以为他会说不是。

sents.en: He said, well, for example, Stan, your kitchen is designed for a human to work in.
sents.zh: 他说：Stan，比如你的厨房，就是按人来设计、给人干活的。

sents.en: So, if you want a humanoid to work for you and do your tasks in the kitchen, it should be a humanoid.
sents.zh: 所以如果你想让机器人替你在厨房干活，那它就该是人形的。

sents.en: He said, in an Amazon factory, it doesn't have to be a humanoid.
sents.zh: 他说，在亚马逊的工厂里，就不必是人形的。

sents.en: By the way, I just learned this yesterday.
sents.zh: 顺便说一句，这是我昨天才知道的。

sents.en: I've been sitting here, I don't know why I hadn't asked him before, thinking about humanoids and how ridiculous this is making robots humans, when there must be a better way to make a functioning robot.
sents.zh: 我一直坐在这儿琢磨人形机器人，觉得把机器人做成人有多荒唐，明明一定有更好的办法造出能干活的机器人——也不知道为什么之前没问过他。

hl.text: , when there must be a better way to make a functioning robot
hl.note: when 的对比用法：「明明…却…」。前面说他觉得荒唐，when 引出「明明有更好的办法」。

sents.en: Gold.
sents.zh: 黄金。

sents.en: Gold.
sents.zh: 黄金。

sents.en: Fascinating.
sents.zh: 很迷人。

sents.en: Tariffs.
sents.zh: 关税。

sents.en: Not a fan.
sents.zh: 不太喜欢。

sents.en: I'm fine with them up to like 10% because we over-consume in this country.
sents.zh: 10% 左右以内我觉得没问题，因为我们这个国家消费过度了。

hl.text: I'm fine with them up to like 10%
hl.note: 先让步：I'm fine with X up to…「在…以内我没意见」，后面再说超过了不行。

sents.en: And if you can have a consumption tax that the foreigners bear part of the burden.
sents.zh: 而如果能有一种消费税，让外国人承担一部分负担。

sents.en: I don't have a problem with them.
sents.zh: 那我不反对。

sents.en: If you get into some of the kind of ranges we've got into, I can't stand them, but, you know, I'm a Ronald Reagan old school economist.
sents.zh: 但要是到了我们之前搞到的那种幅度，我就受不了了——不过你知道，我是里根那一派的老派经济学家。

hl.text: I can't stand them, but, you know, I'm a Ronald Reagan old school economist
hl.note: 转折里再转折：受不了，但我又是里根派，说明立场复杂。

sents.en: But to a point, I think they're fine.
sents.zh: 但在一定限度内，我觉得关税没问题。

hl.text: But to a point, I think they're fine.
hl.note: to a point = 在一定程度上。收尾的让步：有限度地认可。

sents.en: Crypto?
sents.zh: 加密货币？

sents.en: I said this a long time ago, and I'm going to say it again, it's a solution looking for a problem.
sents.zh: 我很久以前就说过，现在再说一遍：它是一个在找问题的解决方案。

sents.en: I'm very sad that it ever happened.
sents.zh: 我很遗憾它出现了。

sents.en: As a store of value, because it wasn't needed, but it's a brand and these people love it, so it's going to be a store of value.
sents.zh: 作为价值储存，它本来是不需要的，但它是一个品牌，这些人爱它，所以它会成为价值储存。

sents.en: On the other hand, blockchain and the use of stablecoins, if you want to throw crypto into that, tokens—incredibly useful in terms of productivity.
sents.zh: 另一方面，区块链和稳定币的应用——如果你想把加密货币也算进去的话，还有代币——在提高生产率上极其有用。

hl.note: On the other hand：另一方面，用来对比前面说的加密货币。

sents.en: I assume our whole payment systems will be stablecoins in 10 or 15 years—efficient, quicker, cheaper.
sents.zh: 我估计 10 到 15 年后，我们整个支付系统都会是稳定币——高效、更快、更便宜。

sents.en: China or China-US relations.
sents.zh: 中国，或者说中美关系。

sents.en: Kevin Warsh said something brilliant about eight years ago when Trump took on China.
sents.zh: 大约八年前特朗普对中国出手的时候，Kevin Warsh 说过一句很精辟的话。

sents.en: He said, this is probably the best China and US relations will ever be.
sents.zh: 他说，现在大概就是中美关系有史以来最好的时候了。

sents.en: They're probably only going to get worse from here.
sents.zh: 往后大概只会越来越糟。

sents.en: And it sounded like the craziest statement I had ever heard, and I converted shortly thereafter.
sents.zh: 我当时觉得这是我听过最疯狂的话，可没过多久我就被说服了。

sents.en: And I think that's still the trend— that our relations are in a bear market.
sents.zh: 我觉得这依然是趋势——两国关系处在熊市里。

sents.en: Europe and the Euro.
sents.zh: 欧洲和欧元。

sents.en: Euro broke my heart because I lived off the Deutsche Mark for ten years, and when they got rid of the Deutsche Mark, my gravy train was over.
sents.zh: 欧元让我心碎，因为我靠德国马克吃了十年饭，他们把德国马克废掉之后，我的好日子就到头了。

sents.en: I never made returns like I made in the '90s again.
sents.zh: 我再也没赚到过 90 年代那样的回报。

sents.en: Look, I don't know, that place— as an American who likes innovation and who likes action as opposed to being a cultural idiot, which is what I am—I'm not, I'm not big on the Euro.
sents.zh: 这么说吧，我不知道——那个地方……作为一个喜欢创新、喜欢干实事的美国人，而不是讲究文化的人——我就是个文化白痴——我不太看好欧元。

sents.en: By the way, there's companies in Europe we've invested in and we think they're great.
sents.zh: 顺便说一句，我们在欧洲也投了一些公司，觉得它们很棒。

sents.en: So it's not an overriding comment.
sents.zh: 所以这不是一棍子打死的评价。

sents.en: Curing cancer.
sents.zh: 治愈癌症。

sents.en: Gonna happen, soon.
sents.zh: 会实现的，很快。

sents.en: What's your market in years?
sents.zh: 「很快」是几年？

sents.en: I think in ten years, 95% of cancers will be just a manageable disease.
sents.zh: 我觉得十年内，95% 的癌症都会变成一种可控的病。

sents.en: Incredible.
sents.zh: 太了不起了。

sents.en: Morgan Stanley.
sents.zh: 摩根士丹利。

sents.en: Quality and trust.
sents.zh: 品质和信任。

sents.en: That's where I go with that firm.
sents.zh: 一提到这家公司，我想到的就是这个。

sents.en: Sounds like a good firm.
sents.zh: 听起来是家好公司。

sents.en: It has some problems with it...
sents.zh: 它也有些问题……

sents.en: Some people.
sents.zh: 有些人。

sents.en: Just maybe one or...
sents.zh: 也就一个或……

sents.en: Two.
sents.zh: 两个。

sents.en: The other thousands are great.
sents.zh: 其他几千人都很棒。

sents.en: Dollar as a reserve currency.
sents.zh: 美元作为储备货币。

sents.en: It's the cleanest, dirtiest shirt or whatever that thing is.
sents.zh: 它是一堆脏衬衫里最干净的那件，大概是这么个说法。

sents.en: Um, I think it'll be around for a while.
sents.zh: 我觉得它还会存在很久。

sents.en: We're doing everything we can to destroy it.
sents.zh: 我们正在尽一切努力去毁掉它。

sents.en: But I'm 72.
sents.zh: 但我 72 岁了。

sents.en: It'll probably outlive me.
sents.zh: 它多半会比我活得长。

sents.en: I doubt it'll be the reserve currency in 50 years, but I don't have a clue what would be.
sents.zh: 我不认为 50 年后它还是储备货币，但会是什么，我毫无头绪。

hl.text: I doubt it'll be the reserve currency in 50 years, but I don't have a clue what would be
hl.note: 让步对比：我不认为它 50 年后还是储备货币，但谁会取代它我也不知道。

sents.en: Maybe some crypto thing I hate.
sents.zh: 也许是某种我讨厌的加密货币吧。

sents.en: Fed and Treasury working together.
sents.zh: 美联储和财政部合作。

sents.en: Can it happen?
sents.zh: 能实现吗？

sents.en: How?
sents.zh: 怎么实现？

sents.en: That's what I'm most excited about with, with Bessent and Warsh.
sents.zh: 这正是我对 Bessent 和 Warsh 最期待的地方。

sents.en: I think it can happen.
sents.zh: 我觉得能实现。

sents.en: I think it's necessary.
sents.zh: 我觉得这是必要的。

sents.en: I can't think of two people better placed in terms of skill sets and personalities to make it happen.
sents.zh: 论能力和性格，我想不出比他们俩更适合把这件事办成的人了。

sents.en: So count me optimistic on that one.
sents.zh: 所以这件事上，算我一个乐观派。

shadow.tips: 断句：I'm TALKing about TRADing the yield curve / as opPOSED to / just trading BONDS OUTright. as opposed to 连读 a-zə-poz-tə。
断句：I'm FINE with them / up to like TEN percent / because we OVer-conSUME / in this COUNtry. fine with them 读成 fine-with-əm。
断句：But to a POINT, / I think they're FINE. to a 连读 tu-wə；point 后停顿。
断句：On the OTHer hand, / BLOCKchain and the use of STABLEcoins, / if you want to throw CRYPto into that, / TOKens, / inCREDibly USEful / in terms of producTIVity. on the other hand 一口气、升调后停。
断句：I DOUBT it'll be the reserve CURrency / in FIFty years, / but I DON'T have a CLUE / what WOULD be. but 前停顿；clue 重读。

questions: What one-word answers did Druckenmiller give for the US economy, biotech and retail investors?
Why did he call the yield curve "overrated"? (Try: "Although it's a pretty good indicator, …")
What did his young partner say about humanoid robots?
What is his view on tariffs? Use "up to" or "to a point".
How does he contrast crypto as a store of value with stablecoins? (Try: "While crypto…, stablecoins…")
Pick two words from the game and answer them yourself, each with a "but". (e.g. "Gold: I like it, but…")

chunks.en: I'm fine with them up to ___

chunks.zh: 一个在找问题的解决方案（没有刚需）

chunks.zh: 这件事算我一个乐观派
